rows.details: G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (NIHE)
In-house 02 project "Resilience Building in Climate - Sensitive Basins in the Indian Himalayan Region- Mapping Vulnerable Hotspots and Communities for Risk Reduction and Adaptation"
Rs. 24,000/- + HRA per month; Rs. 28,000/- + HRA per month (after 2 years)

content_sections.heading: About NIHE Junior Project Fellow
content_sections.text: G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment is located at Kosi-Katarmal, Almora 263643 (Uttarakhand), and the advertised post is at its Garhwal Regional Centre in Srinagar (Garhwal). The Junior Project Fellow will work on the institute's In-house 02 project on mapping vulnerable hotspots and communities in climate-sensitive basins of the Indian Himalayan Region for risk reduction and adaptation. The position is described as purely project-based and temporary, and applications are invited only from Indian citizens.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: First class Master's degree in Environmental Science/Environmental Management/Natural Resource Management/ Plant Science/RS-GIS/Geography or other relevant subjects from a recognized university. Desirable qualifications: Preference will be given to candidates having research experience in Himalaya region. Proficiency required in computer applications and data analysis software i.e. R, SPSS, RS-GIS, Python etc. Age limit: 28 years. The notice does not print an "as on" date for age or any age relaxation. Other eligibility points: Only Indian citizens may apply. Experience will not be considered without an experience certificate. Minimum requirements of qualifications and/or experience can be relaxed in respect of exceptionally outstanding candidates. Candidates should check the official notification for the full subject-wise eligibility for this post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Junior Project Fellow gets Rs. 24,000/- + HRA per month, and Rs. 28,000/- + HRA per month after 2 years. HRA is paid in addition to the stated amount; the notice does not print the HRA rate. The engagement is purely temporary in nature and tied to the project. The total tenure of the position is not specified in the notice. The Institute reserves the right to disengage the manpower at any time without assigning any reasons.

content_sections.heading: NIHE Junior Project Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist PIs in field sample and data collection. Maintenance of data. Statistical data analysis and report writing. PowerPoint presentations. Any other scientific/technical work that may be assigned.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIHE Junior Project Fellow
content_sections.text: Open the NIHE online recruitment portal at gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php; applications are accepted through this portal only. In the application, mention all qualifications and experience in the relevant field over and above the minimum prescribed qualification, supported with documents. Submit the application on or before 11:59 PM on 10 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed separately about the mode of interview, date and time. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not by itself entitle an applicant to be called for an Interview/Test(s). If a large number of applications is received, the institute reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility level to restrict the number of candidates called for interview/test, in line with the number of vacancies; the decision of NIHE is final. Candidates appearing for the interview physically must bring original documents of their educational qualifications and experience along with one set of photocopies. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The selected candidate(s) are expected to join immediately. The selected candidate is liable to be posted anywhere in India. The Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of positions, to fill up or not to fill up any or all the posts, or to shortlist and select candidates in any suitable position depending on qualification and experience. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification. In any dispute or ambiguity about eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection and conduct of examination/interview, the Institute's decision is final and no query or correspondence will be entertained.
